entries.name: PULHRA
entries.author: 646timur-cell
entries.description: A minimal Elektron-style groovebox: four tracks, patterns in banks A to E, parameter locks, trig conditions, chains, an arpeggiator per track and per-pattern kits on the MONOFM sound core. A hard fork of Felucca.

entries.name: ZEN-1
entries.author: aceyprime
entries.description: Ambient as a living window: cherry petals on a river, koi in a pond, fireflies under a real moon, and every movement a note. Set it down and let it play; the keys play along, the knobs shape the scene.

entries.name: Unholy Union
entries.author: actuallysparky
entries.description: Generative ambient and drone: Immaculate Permutation rolls an arrangement in one key, a pad, a sequence and a chord arpeggio under a fourth voice for your hands. Keep a sermon you like, evolve it, or reveal another.

entries.name: Fart Machine One
entries.author: adamcharleswilsonmusic-code
entries.description: A questionable musical instrument: eleven artisanal farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer.

entries.name: CLATTER Pocket
entries.author: allmyfriendsaresynths
entries.description: A generative drum machine on the LXR sound engine. Seven voices, kits grown from a seed in 16 characters, a 64-step sequencer with conditions and per-step pitch, patterns generated and mutated in 11 styles, MIDI notes and clock in, and nine named projects.

entries.name: ASS-ID
entries.author: altessproduction
entries.description: The ATEK303 acid groovebox plus a drum track on the same clock: eight synthesized TR-808/909/707 voices, no samples, a seeded 64-step generator with mutations and LOCK for both tracks, an 8x16 drum matrix, swing, three kits, drive, chorus, delay, reverb and eight factory presets.

entries.name: sloop-DUB
entries.author: altessproduction
entries.description: The SLOOP groovebox for the M-VAVE FM-1, forked for dub: a four-band isolator with mute bands, a bipolar DJ filter, per-track echo throws, a tape echo with free time or synced divisions, an independent siren voice, skank, accents and slides — with a sound-system bank of 180 genre presets (ska to…

entries.name: S1Vave
entries.author: Andrew GG
entries.description: An 8-voice virtual analog tweak synth: authentic 4-pole resonant filter, dual sub-oscillator, ADSR envelopes, 64-step sequencer, and hands-on live performance controls.

entries.name: ATEK303
entries.author: Animatek
entries.description: A TB-303 style acid synth with its own pattern generator: press PLAY and a line plays. Generate, mutate and undo patterns up to 64 steps, edit steps in a piano roll, add drive, chorus, synced delay and plate reverb. The ATEK303 engine from VCV Rack with 14 oscillators and its fine tuning, 12…

entries.name: FMEL-1
entries.author: Antonio Altea
entries.description: Mellotron-style tape sounds, coloured with effects and lo-fi tape: flutes, strings and choirs as on the old tape frames, played from the keys.

entries.name: TRIBE
entries.author: apiel
entries.description: A ten-track groovebox built on X0X where any engine plays on any track: kicks, 909 and 808 voices, a 303, sixteen clips a track and scatter effects.

entries.name: KARMA
entries.author: Ariel Muchnik
entries.description: A four-track groovebox: an acid bass or a Juno-style poly, physical modelling, two dozen synthesis models and a drum synth. A 64-step sequencer with song mode, generators that write parts on one chord plan, pixel characters, and USB audio with six stems, MIDI out and DAW sync.

entries.name: April OS
entries.author: beashoko
entries.description: A sampler inspired by the Casio SK-1: no synth engines, only samples, recorded through the installer page's microphone bridge.

entries.name: CULTBOX
entries.author: beatcult
entries.description: A three-channel groovebox: a Polivoks-style duophonic synth (PLVKS), an Elka-style sample drum machine with a step sequencer, and a dub siren, with BBD echoes, per-channel character effects, arp, scales and a mixer with panning.

entries.name: HERA
entries.author: Ben Badio
entries.description: A chord groovebox after the Roland J-6: 100 chord sets, 9 phrase styles with 12 variations each and a 64-pattern step sequencer, on a four-voice Juno-style synth from Clipper with chorus, delay and reverb. A chord map on the screen shows which chord sits on which key. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: MORPHEUS
entries.author: Ben Badio
entries.description: A pattern sequencer after Reason's Matrix: up to four channels of MIDI sequence data out, and a few voices built in to build the patterns with.

entries.name: Kitten Synths
entries.author: Black Kitten Devices
entries.description: NEW: two drum tracks. Four synths (one a Minimoog-style MUUG with 100 sounds, plus a light LITE synth) and two drum kits play at once, and the FM-1 records 8 channels into your DAW over USB: the stereo master plus each of the six tracks. A SLOOP 2.8 groovebox with the fixes of 2.8.4, 64 steps…

entries.name: Kitten Rack
entries.author: Black Kitten Devices
entries.description: A Eurorack-style modular synth: over 50 modules (VCOs, a Moog-style ladder, a low pass gate, Turing, Marbles, chaos, effects) patched with cables on the FM-1 itself, a 64-step sequencer with live recording, 33 factory patches, visuals, USB audio and MIDI.

entries.name: Jam Playground
entries.author: Bob Perry
entries.description: Jam Playground plays a new song the moment you turn the FM-1 on. Four synths and eleven drums sound together. Turn a knob to change the vibe, the scale, a sound, or an effect, and play along.

entries.name: Caravel
entries.author: BonszaiMusic
entries.description: Multi-engine synth firmware with DRONE, STASIS texture capture, Pair Morph, and per-track Random Morph and Morph Journey for evolving, ambient and experimental sound design. Sequencer, MIDI Learn, USB audio.

entries.name: Dungeon Tracker
entries.author: Bourbon Weather
entries.description: A four-track groovebox that is a dungeon crawler: your party plays the music, the rogue drums, the fighter bass, the cleric pads and the mage the melody. Step-program in a tracker or record live, and see how deep you get.

entries.name: FuMi-1
entries.author: cartesive
entries.description: Inspired by the Suiko ST-50 shigin conductor: koto and shakuhachi-style tones.

entries.name: Felucca [Salt]
entries.author: ChanceTheMaker
entries.description: A Felucca fork with its own sound and editor changes.

entries.name: LOOM-8
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: A groovebox inspired by the OP-XY: eight tracks on nine engines, step tricks and locks, weave, a conductor and throws.

entries.name: MONK-1
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Twelve singers, from Jerry the monk to Snider the punk, each in its own voice: MonkSynth's formant voices, played with velocity and pressure from the FM-1's own keys.

entries.name: AMB-1
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: A generative ambient machine inspired by Music for Airports.

entries.name: CTL-1
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: A MIDI controller: the keys play in a scale with its chords on the black keys, four banks of knobs, an arpeggiator and Euclidean drums, with General MIDI sounds of its own.

entries.name: FoMni
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: A chord harp inspired by the Omnichord: hold a chord, strum the keys.

entries.name: Polly
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: A pocket arranger after the Yamaha QY70: pick a style, play a chord and a band of eight follows, with General MIDI sounds.

entries.name: X0X
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: A groovebox: 909, 808, two 303s and a break player. Pick a drum with a black key, set steps with the white keys, then PLAY.

entries.name: CORD
entries.author: Chase DeAnda
entries.description: Pick a chord progression, press Play, and play along with drums, bass and chords. Adjust the progression, sounds and groove to build backing tracks for practicing, jamming and writing songs.

entries.name: Loom FM-1
entries.author: Co-oscillator
entries.description: Four synth and sampler tracks and a drum track on 14 engines, among them wavetable, 6-op FM, tape scrub, granular and a slicer; a 64-step sequencer, a chord progression generator, macros and sidechain ducking.

entries.name: NACHTFAHRT
entries.author: Cranky Man
entries.description: Generative 1970s Berlin School: two sequencers drift against each other over a drone, in eight endless pieces. Play a melody on the white keys and the lead answers it, takes it as its theme and grows new ideas from it.

entries.name: AISLING
entries.author: CU_STE
entries.description: A generative Irish ambient instrument: harps in a jig's threes and a flute over a held drone, with surf, wind and rain. Eight pieces play themselves for ever; play the flute on the white keys and it answers you. Plug it in and its **visualiser** paints what it plays as an Irish landscape, live.

entries.name: fm1-amy
entries.author: Dan Ellis
entries.description: A six-voice analog-style synth: AMY's emulations of the 128 Juno-60 factory patches, shaped with the AMYboard editor's patch knobs (oscillators, LFO, filter, envelopes, EQ, chorus, reverb, distortion) on eleven colour-coded pages. Plays over USB MIDI, and the AMYboard editor can edit it live.

entries.name: Elixir
entries.author: Dan Majka
entries.description: A super powerful drum synth and sequencer that started as a port of the Erica Synths LXR-02 and kept going. Make a beat in two minutes, then dig into 29 sound engines, deep effects, generative sequencing, live performance tricks, MIDI control and 8-channel USB audio.

entries.name: FM-FAM
entries.author: David Amo
entries.description: Dfam style 16-step sequencer and a drum synth: two oscillators with 16 wave types, a kick with its own sequencer, parameter locks, a sound saved per pattern, an effects chain, random pages, scales, presets and projects.

entries.name: Ravel
entries.author: De-Pattern
entries.description: An eight-track groovebox for sound design: thirteen synth engines, struck percussion and 33 drum machines after the Machinedrum, on an influence grid where any track can trigger, excite or modulate any other.

entries.name: FMDj
entries.author: DEADACTIVE
entries.description: Game Boy music programs on the FM-1: LSDj, the tracker, and DMGo!, the drum machine, in a Game Boy emulator on its screen, keys and knobs. Bring your own ROM: the install page puts it in, in your browser.

entries.name: Hortator
entries.author: DeadActive
entries.description: A drum-focused firmware based on Felucca.

entries.name: Hortator (Bluetooth)
entries.author: DEADACTIVE
entries.description: Hortator's Bluetooth build: the same eight-track drum machine, plus Bluetooth MIDI for a BLE keyboard or clock, or the M-VAVE SMC-Mixer as a mixer for the eight tracks. Reads the plain version's projects.

entries.name: PERF-1
entries.author: deamonSLINKY
entries.description: A generative groovebox you perform on: ten genres of self-playing pieces, an auto-DJ with breakdowns, builds and drops, Euclidean drums, an acid line that answers itself, beat FX and DX7-style FM voices from your own .syx.

entries.name: Daurade
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative French house after a certain robotic duo: a filtered loop opening over sixteen bars, a mix that pumps on every kick and a robot voice singing the hook. Ten styles, four knobs, drops, solos, the lead on the keys.

entries.name: Flyfish
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: One piece on the FM-1: Chopin's Étude Op. 10 No. 1 on a sampled Steinway D. It plays the étude, lets you shape it with rubato, touch and accents, practise it and move it. Built on Tuna and Felucca.

entries.name: Makohai
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: A generative groovebox in the style of early-90s PC tracker music: six lanes (lead, arp, pad, bass, drums, sfx) composed live in ten S3M-scene styles. You mix styles instead of programming steps. Built on Tuna and Felucca.

entries.name: Sardine
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Live club mixing for the FM-1: four layers (lead, chord, bass, drums) that play by themselves in 20 styles while you ride them live. Blend one style into the next, build with intros and break-build-drop arcs, edit steps or play a layer by hand. All synthesised but the piano.

entries.name: Sill
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative 90s eurodance, pickled in 1995: a song in intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus and break, with lift, pump, vox and energy on the knobs, the hook, the groove and a key change up for the last chorus. Eight sets to store. On Felucca, after Tuna.

entries.name: Tuna
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative music built on Felucca: composer profiles write the music as it plays, you steer them. A work in progress.

entries.name: SIDOU
entries.author: Denis Sablić
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID machine: two SIDs (6581 and 8580) with the chip's character dialled in, a GoatTracker 2 compatible tracker and step sequencer, and a live instrument to play over a song.

entries.name: LSDJ Burrito
entries.author: dreamsofbacon
entries.description: Source of Dreamy_bacon's LSDJ Burrito: LSDj on the M-VAVE FM-1, based on GameDude (GPL-3.0). No ROMs included.

compat.note: boots to its instructions, but makes no audio until an LSDJ song is sent to it over USB from its web page, which the emulator's page cannot do

entries.name: ESTAMPIE
entries.author: Drew Robinson
entries.description: A groovebox for lively mediæval dance music: hurdy-gurdy, lutes, shawms and frame drums over drones, four tracks with 64-step sequencers, mediæval modes and temperaments, and velocity from the FM-1's own keys. Built on GHOULBOX and Felucca.

entries.name: MC-1
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: An original four-part groovebox with a 1990s workflow: three melodic parts and a 16-lane drum part, 128 melodic presets, eight drum kits, song arrangement, an arpeggiator and recorded knob moves.

entries.name: ORBIT
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: A four-track groovebox based on SLOOP: three synth parts and a drum machine, an event tape to rearrange them, OP-1-inspired screens.

entries.name: Golana DZ Edition
entries.author: dzwerg
entries.description: Golana's synth with a sequencer for whole songs: 64 steps a pattern, 32 programs (up to 2,048 steps), a SONGMODE that plays from a first to a last program once or on repeat, and USB MIDI out to sequence other synths.

entries.name: keySTEP ONE
entries.author: dzwerg
entries.description: A four-track MIDI arranger and controller for the M-VAVE FM-1. Create patterns, songs and albums, switch patterns live, route USB and Bluetooth MIDI, and play sounds with the onboard General MIDI synth.

entries.name: Argo
entries.author: echoe
entries.description: An LLM-written expansion of Felucca with samples removed and a few synth engines added, with a focus on multiple patterns per track, per-step patch switching, and synthesis. This firmware was previously known as Felucca 8 patterns.

entries.name: Felucca 8 Patterns
entries.author: echoe
entries.description: Felucca 1.5.1 with eight sequences a track to switch between and chain one after another; the user samples are left out to make room.

entries.name: WaveLoop FM-1
entries.author: ELI7VH
entries.description: A Felucca mod: standalone Arturia MiniLab 3 control, fine track mixing, a DJ filter, momentary effects and MIDI feedback.

entries.name: Pocket Band
entries.author: elpabl0
entries.description: A band in your FM-1. Pick a spot on a map of 16 genre towns and it writes a four-piece sketch: drums, bass, keys and lead in one key. Re-roll parts, audition players, jam, morph, play punch-in effects, edit steps, save four slots. With a rhythm game played over your own drum part.

entries.name: Bubba Machine
entries.author: Erbubar23
entries.description: A six-track groovebox written from scratch: TR drums from Plaits' 808 and 909 models, a sampler with a 16-slice slicer, a bass and three free tracks (analog, 6-op FM, 303 acid), scenes and fills, all at 44.1 kHz.

entries.name: DX747
entries.author: Esben von Buchwald
entries.description: An eight-part multitimbral DX7 module. Every part has its own MIDI channel and up to eight layered DX7 voices, with key splits, velocity windows and 64 scenes. A master filter, shared reverb and delay, DX7 ROM import and a web configurator. Played and controlled over MIDI.

entries.name: Niagara Drift
entries.author: evanyerburgh
entries.description: A drone synth: two drifting virtual-analog drones, each with its own part, swells, LFOs, effects and a sequencer.

entries.name: VESPER
entries.author: Fat Cat Studios
entries.description: An ambient worship synth. Each scene layers four lush voices in any major key around a crystal orbit home screen: pads, plucks, piano and swells. Shape them with drive, tone, granular clouds, shimmer, reverb and delay, then play live over the scene or record into it.

entries.name: DRIFT
entries.author: FBNFRTG
entries.description: An ambient instrument for live sessions: warm synths, spacious pads and delicate plucks over a generative Euclidean sequencer on one track, with delays and reverbs from spring to shimmer. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: CoralFlower
entries.author: FicusFicusov
entries.description: Chords after the Orchid, with a UX made for the FM-1: one key turns every note into a chord with a bass, 27 scales, an arpeggiator, a looper, a plate reverb, and a pixel flower that grows as you play.

entries.name: LOAF BREAKER
entries.author: FLEXOR
entries.description: A hardcore kick synthesizer powerhouse and a breakbeat chopper (gabber, terror, speedcore): a heavy kick with its own synth, DISTO and SCREAM distortion, effects and twenty memories, breaks sliced on the white keys, effects on the black keys, snare, hat, clap, songs with builds and drops, a…

entries.name: Golana
entries.author: Gadlele
entries.description: One analog-style synth laid out like the classic microKORG, with a screen that draws the sound.

entries.name: Vector37
entries.author: genkigenki
entries.description: An orbiting overtone synth: four corners of two overtone generators each, a sun on a path and a moon around it decide how much of each you hear; the knobs shape the selected planet. Made for the SMK-37, here its FM-1 build. After the Beetlecrab Vector.

entries.name: Matryoshka
entries.author: glvno
entries.description: A modular synth you patch in the browser: modules (oscillators, filters, envelopes, delays) nest into assemblies you save and reuse, and the patch plays on the FM-1, polyphonic with a Voicing module.

entries.name: KRIECHSTROM
entries.author: Grigorii Bezborodov
entries.description: Firmware for dark industrial and EBM, built on Felucca. Adds the GLCH distortion engine from Glitchbox, 171 sounds and 13 drum kits, DICE to generate parts in eight styles, random sound variations, tape and digital degradation of the mix, and a manual in English and Russian.

entries.name: GR!MM
entries.author: GRiMMBIENT
entries.description: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream: four tracks, seven sound sources from VA and 6-op FM to formant voices and physical models, tape, granular freeze and reverbs up to infinite, a 64-step sequencer and song mode. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: PaperLagoon
entries.author: hacha
entries.description: A generative ambient firmware. FM voices through a tape echo and a plate play by themselves in seven worlds that exist nowhere. You steer from outside: a key offers something to a hidden state, the knobs change the weather, and the music answers slowly.

entries.name: No Man Sky FM
entries.author: Hericdk
entries.description: A space adventure while you make music, built on SLOOP 2.7.1: fly between planets with two knobs, land, mine, fight sentinels and warp between stars, every SLOOP screen floating over the game.

entries.name: FM1 Quest
entries.author: hericdk
entries.description: A live RPG adventure inside the synth.

entries.name: winampFM Synth
entries.author: hericdk
entries.description: Winamp 2.x on the FM-1, built on SLOOP: your sounds as a playlist, four tracks recorded as loops, effects on sliders and a visualizer of lines.

entries.name: MODELAR
entries.author: Hirakos
entries.description: A semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four oscillators modulating each other through eight routings, and keys that move a cursor on an XY pad instead of playing notes: white keys are points, black keys gestures. ARP, a polymetric sequencer, a clock in Hz and eight generative environme…

entries.name: M-PYRE
entries.author: History Of Sky
entries.description: A riffbox for rock and metal: real guitar, bass and drum samples, an amp engine with cabinet IRs, pedals and guitar effects, plus all of SLOOP's synth engines. Bend strings, play whammy, wah and palm mutes live, record on the 4-track and turn riffs into songs.

entries.name: PT/FM
entries.author: hitosu
entries.description: A ProTracker-style pocket studio: DX7 FM, JUNO-106, TB-303, chip, sampler and FUSION instruments side by side, 16 voices on both cores, a loop station, a two-deck DJ mode, punch-in effects and over 500 built-in instruments.

entries.name: LUXR
entries.author: HOLODECK AUDIOTOOLS
entries.description: An LXR-style drum machine: eight sounds, each a synth and a sample layer, with drive, delay, reverb, filter, compressor and limiter. 16 patterns of up to 64 steps, per-track speed, locks, conditional trigs, chains and song mode, MIDI clock and CC learn. Its samples are the Sonic Potions LXR's, non-…

entries.name: Felucca
entries.author: hugelton
entries.description: The original open firmware: a four-operator FM synth with sequencer, arpeggiator and effects.

entries.name: MONO2K
entries.author: Iñigo Hernandez
entries.description: Six mono machines in the spirit of Elektron's Monomachine: FM, superwaves, wavetables, a SID, a voice and four drum synths, one per track. A 64-step sequencer with parameter locks, trig conditions and ratchets, a lofi bus, four demo parts and a web patch editor.

entries.name: MIDIMON
entries.author: ignis32
entries.description: A MIDI monitor for USB, the TRS jack and Bluetooth (as device and host at once): hex or words, filters, stats. Its THRU routes, each filtered, make the FM-1 a Bluetooth MIDI dongle.

entries.name: Skiff
entries.author: illuminus5
entries.description: A six-track groovebox built on Felucca 1.1.5: fourteen synth and drum engines, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets and locks, songs and a performance layer.

entries.name: Clipper
entries.author: isod89
entries.description: A deep synth grown out of SLOOP: 23 engines and 407 sounds, from HYBRID (three oscillators, two filters, a mod matrix) to six-operator FM, wavetables, wave sequencing, a Juno and physical models; arp, step sequencer, MPE and a web editor for every parameter.

entries.name: SLOOP
entries.author: isod89
entries.description: A live groovebox: four looping tracks.

entries.name: GATOR
entries.author: ivanvoid
entries.description: A monophonic macro-oscillator on the open Plaits DSP: all 24 models with harmonics, timbre and morph, an 8-slot mod matrix fed by an envelope, two LFOs, velocity, aftertouch and random, a low-pass gate, and a DRONE mode.

entries.name: J6
entries.author: JackieAlacrity2373
entries.description: A six-voice JUNO-60 style polysynth with chorus, arpeggiator and a 16-step recorder. 56 factory sounds, a MIDI control for every knob, and a free browser editor that plays it over USB-MIDI.

entries.name: FiMba-1
entries.author: jadamsowers
entries.description: A physically modelled kalimba (thumb piano), with mbira patterns, tape and grains. Built on Felucca, X0X and FoMni.

entries.name: FM1-GM
entries.author: jartificer
entries.description: A General MIDI sequencer with 16 tracks, 128 General MIDI instruments to choose from and a drum kit (on track 10). It can store up to 64 songs, each containing up to 128 measures.

entries.name: FM1-TRAX
entries.author: jartificer
entries.description: A Mega Drive / Genesis music tracker. It emulates the YM2612 and SN76489 chips: six FM channels, three square waves and noise, with Deflemask-style effects, 128 FM presets, a drum kit on the DAC, 256 song slots, a demo song and VGM export.

entries.name: GHOULBOX
entries.author: jasonpersinger
entries.description: Dungeon synth (a Felucca fork): cathedral reverb and dark drones.

entries.name: Rhythmer
entries.author: Jazzy Rhythmer
entries.description: A hands-on groovebox firmware for the FM-1. Shape sounds, build patterns, and find your own groove. Up to six assignable tracks, sound design, sequencing and performance. Free and open source, built on JIANT and reworked by Jazzy Rhythmer.

entries.name: Del Rio
entries.author: Jess Del Rio
entries.description: A rhythm box of ceremony percussion: djembe, cajon, udu, clapsticks, maracas and triangle, their real strokes on the black keys, a step sequencer on the white keys and 31 rhythms from the literature. Played alone: a berimbau with its caxixi, a buzzing tanpura and a breathing shruti box. Built on fm…

entries.name: PLAYA
entries.author: JFS
entries.description: A performance firmware built on Optimist: two synth layers on one keyboard (layer, split, blend or single), drums with a simple step sequencer, send effects, Bluetooth MIDI keyboards, and one easy to read screen with knobs 1-4 to edit all parameters. 5 engines, 32 drum kits, 135 presets.

entries.name: Berlinan
entries.author: Jiří Píša
entries.description: A generative Berlin School MIDI sequencer: a small ensemble of voices that repeat, phase against each other on loops of unequal length and earn their mutations over time. The FM-1 makes no sound with it: each voice goes out over USB on its own MIDI channel to your synths, as Berlinan for macOS…

entries.name: Scintilla
entries.author: Joakim Eriksson
entries.description: The 1981 Elka Synthex on the FM-1: all 80 factory sounds, Paul Wiffen's laser harp among them, checked sample by sample against the original. Two layers of 8 voices (single, split, double), poly, mono or unison, chorus and reverb, and the four knobs edit what is on the screen.

entries.name: fm1-dock
entries.author: joakimeriksson
entries.description: One firmware, many synths: CS-1, Scintilla and OberVave as modules in flash, the sine built in; HOME opens the picker. Add FM-106, MONK-1, FiMba-1, GATOR, DUB-1, FM-1 SID, AMB-1 or FoMni from its page with one click; Bluetooth MIDI with both cores, a master EQ, MIDI options. Formerly harbor.

entries.name: FM-1 SID
entries.author: joakimeriksson
entries.description: A SID chip on the FM-1, its own firmware on fm1-dock (fm1-dock's USB, installer and rescue; the sine as the fallback): a C64 tune player (reSID 0.16 and a 6510 running the tune's own code, PSID and RSID) starting with GoatTracker 2's example songs, Dojo first; a GoatTracker editor; and a synth: the…

entries.name: B1
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: B1 turns the M-VAVE FM1 into a compact drawbar rock organ with 91 shared tonewheels, nine drawbars per registration, percussion, Leslie, B3/ROCK tones, MIDI and expressive live controls.

entries.name: BEETLE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: A tracker for the FM-1: patterns written top to bottom, step by step, with note, instrument, chord and effect columns, the way trackers have always worked.

entries.name: BEETLE BLUE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: BEETLE BLUE turns your M-VAVE FM1 into a six-lane drum tracker. Build beats with BEETLE and MONOLITH kits, design custom drums, arrange songs, and perform setlists with Live Mode and hands-on effects.

entries.name: RUPTURE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: A monophonic bass synth on Cycle Exchange Synthesis: two sub-oscillators, a ladder filter, Channel EQ, eight effects from MOSFET drive to octave fuzz, a step sequencer up to 128 steps and an arpeggiator.

entries.name: Rainbow Mode
entries.author: joshbartlettband-web
entries.description: A music toy for little hands (a Felucca fork).

entries.name: JIANT FM
entries.author: juanjiant-bit
entries.description: A bio-synthetic groovebox: six tracks drawn as living beings, eight engines (FM6 with Dexed, analog, phase, voice), mutating macros and SLOOP's song mode. Still in development.

entries.name: Melodee
entries.author: keremimo
entries.description: Total playing pleasure, far beyond Felucca: recording without quantize, microtonal scales, a Casio CZ-1, a bit-by-bit Dexed, scale modes made for an MPC Sample as its companion.

entries.name: ARTIHIVE
entries.author: KHAV
entries.description: Eight-voice experimental drone and polyphonic FM synthesizer with four interacting pairs, envelopes, legato glide, hyper LFO, stereo motion, dual modulated delay and a 1-16 step arpeggiator and sequencer. Artistically inspired by SOMA LYRA-8; independently developed.

entries.name: Bunker Evolved
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: Generative ambient: four editable layers from 64 sound recipes, 24 worlds, 24 motifs and 32 scales. GROW varies the phrases, seven EVOLVE processes change them over time. Felucca's sound pages stay. Built on Felucca 1.6.1.

entries.name: Cut-A-Dor
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: A beat dojo for scratch DJs and beatmakers: boom bap, lo-fi and breaks from 16 rhythm families with swing and fills, an eight-lane 32-step sequencer, punch-in effects you record bar by bar, a bass voice. Sound banks and editor in the browser.

entries.name: Mutable Dreams
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: A generative instrument after a small modular setup: six interchangeable tracks on eight engines (selected Plaits algorithms, Rings' modal resonator, a Choir of its own), 64 Biomes, Euclidean rhythms with probability, four macros and a granular bus. Plays and edits in the browser.

entries.name: FOMAJAM
entries.author: konsumer
entries.description: A drum machine in the classic step-grid style: voices after the 909, 808, 707, 606, DMX and more, a machine per voice, accents and patterns. Play it in the browser first.

entries.name: XMOD
entries.author: Kot Morderca
entries.description: A MOD / XM tracker, sampler and groovebox: play, write and save FastTracker 2 and ProTracker songs on the FM-1, up to 32 channels, with a ProTracker mode for MODs and a song manager in the browser for moving songs to and from the computer.

entries.name: M-Vance
entries.author: Kris (bk40-home)
entries.description: A JP-8000/8080-style virtual analog on eight voices: the JT-8000 engine ported to the FM-1, with Super Saw, the JP filter, multi-effects, delay, a plate reverb, an arpeggiator and 64 programs, every knob on the JP-8080's own MIDI CCs.

entries.name: DEEP FIELD
entries.author: Kyle McCann
entries.description: A drone synth with velocity-sensitive keys. Press a key and a voice plays until you stop it: eight voices, thirteen sounds. Motion modes move them in your scale: single notes, chords, chord progressions, arpeggios. Chorus, delay and reverb with freeze. A mixer for drone, lead and effects.

entries.name: Frodhes
entries.author: Leonardo Mirabal
entries.description: A Rhodes electric piano, physically modelled, no samples: four piano types, compressor, drive, tremolo or wah, phaser, chorus, delay and reverb, tap tempo, MIDI clock, scales and presets. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: Skiff Atlatl
entries.author: LIkst4
entries.description: A six-track groovebox for the FM-1, forked from Skiff: a SYNTH with analog, 303 and Plaits-style oscillators, an acid filter and OberVave presets, a Minimoog voice, classic drum models, more trig conditions, a step arpeggiator, 8-channel USB audio, a web editor and screen mirroring.

entries.name: Bytemania
entries.author: lloyd (llozd)
entries.description: A bytebeat synth: play one-line formulas, tweak them with the knobs, and write your own, with a random button in the formula creator that is really fun. A beta, built on Dinghy.

entries.name: Ombak
entries.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
entries.description: A gamelan-inspired ensemble. Lead the core melody on the white keys and the ensemble answers: interlocking kotekan, reyong, kendang and gongs in measured Balinese and Javanese tunings, every note shimmering with ombak. Play the traditional forms, or slow it right down for meditation.

entries.name: Penumbra
entries.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
entries.description: A cinematic space drone you travel through, not one that plays itself. Five drone voices hold a pedal; turn PRESET and they glide to the next scene one voice at a time, or MORPH there by hand. Play VOX over it in key, loop it and the loop follows the key, or hold a key to bend and throw the sound.

entries.name: M-VAVE stock firmware (your copy)
entries.author: M-VAVE
entries.description: M-VAVE's current version (V16 since October 2026), the one its update page installs: a DX7-style FM synth, both cores running. This page does not host it and cannot download it (M-VAVE's server does not allow other pages to): download FM-1.fwsc from M-VAVE, then open it here; this browser keeps it …

entries.name: M-VAVE stock firmware
entries.author: M-VAVE
entries.description: The firmware the FM-1 ships with, version 15: a DX7-style FM synth, both cores running. M-VAVE publishes this version under the Apache License 2.0, as the recovery image of its FM1 Open SDK; it plays here from the FM-1 Firmware Hub's unchanged copy. Its patches live in flash an update does not carr…

compat.note: RTF 0.54 @240 / 0.70 @120 JIT; too slow live on reference PC

entries.name: SLOOP DX7 Banks
entries.author: majnikool
entries.description: SLOOP with up to twelve DX7 voice banks and presets grouped by kind. Test builds.

entries.name: Quartet
entries.author: MammothCheese
entries.description: A four-track groovebox that plays like a four-piece band: lead, pads, bass and drums. 40 sounds and 10 drum kits, 5 effect pedals, an arpeggiator, step and live recording, and a song sequencer where each instrument follows its own arrangement.

entries.name: SPLITMILK
entries.author: MammothCheese
entries.description: SPLITMILK is a performance-focused firmware that separates the keyboard into two independent instruments, with chords, arpeggiators, effects and an adjustable split. Play both instruments live over built-in drum and pad sequencers to create music without endless menu-diving.

entries.name: MYCELIUM
entries.author: Mandalars
entries.description: Forest, Psytrance, Goa and Hitech grooves, built on Felucca and SLOOP: original drums and icons and four factory songs. A test release: not yet fully tested on the device.

entries.name: Guru-600
entries.author: Marc Massé
entries.description: The FM-1 becomes a Prophet-600: 255 sounds (the 100 factory programs, 100 from the free 2022 collection, 55 of its own), a web editor in 7 languages with a panel inspired by the Prophet-600, four tracks with sequencer, arpeggiator, morph and two insert effects each. Based on Felucca.

entries.name: Monohull
entries.author: Mark White
entries.description: A monosynth: one voice with analogue-modelled oscillators and five filters (ladder, diode ladder, OTA, Sallen-Key, state-variable), unison, chorus, delay and reverb, and 14 presets.

entries.name: TastyWaves
entries.author: marksweiss
entries.description: A 12-voice wavetable synth: two oscillators a voice, a resonant filter, two envelopes, an LFO, four effects, an arpeggiator and two step sequencers for chords and counterpoint; load your own Serum, WaveEdit, Ableton or Surge tables.

entries.name: fm1-chord
entries.author: math0ne
entries.description: A chord machine after the HiChord, with extras: chords in a key under the white keys, slash chords and inversions, sounds, envelopes, effects and a looper.

entries.name: Patchwerk
entries.author: Matt Kuebrich
entries.description: A modular synth for the FM-1. With over 80 modules, including synth engines, samplers, filters, effects, sequencers, and generative tools, you can build, patch, and perform directly on the hardware.

entries.name: Miku-FM
entries.author: Michael Perry
entries.description: A singing songwriter: a pixel singer sings your songs in Japanese, consonants and all, over FM chords, bass and drums. Shape her voice with effects, harmony and five characters, write patterns or let her generate a whole song, and watch her dance. 8 song slots.

entries.name: Evander's Music Box
entries.author: Michail Tsakiroglou
entries.description: A bard's instrument for LARP, medieval and high fantasy: recorder, hurdy-gurdy, harp and a tavern kit on four tracks, encounters and songs for the table. "Mother Melody hears thy song."

entries.name: Mighty Arp
entries.author: Moby Pixel
entries.description: Mighty Arp, from the creator of Mighty Synth Sampler, is a 4-op FM/subtractive synth built around a chance arpeggiator. Just hold a chord and let chance play the melody. 50 sounds plus a RANDOM mode that invents new ones, a 32-step sequencer, chords, effects and more.

entries.name: X0X-RMX
entries.author: Mr-Roboto (Oliver)
entries.description: X0X remixed after The Orb: banks and patterns reordered live per voice, Grids MAP and EUCLID drum generation, an extended TB-3PO with 22 scales and a morphing 303 waveform. Built on X0X.

entries.name: Nauclerus
entries.author: Mr. Roboto
entries.description: Hortator's eight-track groovebox taken further: ORB Remix with 256 pattern mappings, the TB-3PO acid melody generator with 22 scales, more acid waveshaping, four bipolar LFOs and Grids rhythms copied into editable steps.

entries.name: Wanderer
entries.author: Nicholas James / Low Vision Music
entries.description: Wanderer 1.4: author-tested synth for low-vision musicians. Protect an Anchor, evolve two layers, play 100 sounds, eight Scatter modes and a 13-pattern arp. Adaptive/steady Zoom, clear knob controls, adjustable display hold and optional audio cues.

entries.name: Bigorna
entries.author: Nuno Zimas
entries.description: Rhythmic noise, power noise, industrial and IDM after the Elektron Digitone II: six tracks, four machines (4-OP, DRUM, WAVY, HIVE), parameter locks on a 16-step sequencer, a looper, send effects and USB audio.

entries.name: Tonitor
entries.author: Nuno Zimas
entries.description: Six tracks for live ambient and experimental music: three synth engines, patches generated by algorithm, free-length loops with up to ten overdubs each, a granulator, filters and a lush reverb.

entries.name: Blop
entries.author: Obsimo
entries.description: Explore sound with your Blop: one-finger chords from 38 grids, chord rhythms, a bass with its own riffs and a few discreet drums with sidechain, while a little creature swims to your chords in an aquarium on the screen. Chords and bass go out as MIDI over USB.

entries.name: SATIE-1
entries.author: OCKM Studio
entries.description: Erik. Evolved. Ten Satie pieces become an evolving electronic soundtrack in five moods. Choose a tune, set the pace and blend Solo, Duet or Trio. Shape each instrument, add vinyl colour and synced delay, or simply let it play. GLO opens the quick guide.

entries.name: Tack
entries.author: oikoaudio
entries.description: A seven-voice drum synth on the LXR firmware's engine. Its step sequencer has per-lane length and direction. Steps have parameter locks, chance and pass conditions, so one pattern can change from pass to pass. It loads LXR-02 .SND kits, sends 10 channels of USB audio and syncs to MIDI clock.

entries.name: MAKU
entries.author: okumurari
entries.description: An ambience machine for DJ interludes: switch it on and a random world in key plays, four parts, buttons that are verbs, and the worlds you like breed new ones. Clock follow. Play it in the browser first.

entries.name: BB1
entries.author: Ole Big Beat / TexasRADIO
entries.description: Two independent drum layers and Dillo, an Open303-derived acid bass, through tape echo and spring reverb: a synthesised 808 and seven sampled machines, 67 songs, 21 eras and 205 ACID phrases.

entries.name: K-WASUB
entries.author: Omnipotard (Guizmoh)
entries.description: K-WA SUB is a powerful bass synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1, featuring 9 synthesis engines with 2 engines playable simultaneously and morphing capabilities. A dedicated sample layer adds attack and texture, while 3 freely assignable MIDI-learnable LFOs, quantized live effects and extensive sound…

entries.name: KAWA
entries.author: Omnipotard
entries.description: A pocket tracker for chiptune and IDM: six tracks of pulse, 4-bit wave, noise, 6-operator FM, drum kits and samples. Chain patterns into songs, chop breaks, and play 64 live effects (with K-GLITCH's DESTROY and BEAT), a filter and an FX sequencer.

entries.name: Carnac OS
entries.author: OrbVorgis
entries.description: A dual-timbral wavetable synth after Carnac's standing stones: 15 morphing wavetable banks, seven voice architectures, a MAQ 16/3-style sequencer for modulated sequences and a chord sequencer for progressions, spring, tomb and tank reverbs. Its own installer also writes its wavetables. Built on X0X…

entries.name: DUELL
entries.author: OSCILL/R
entries.description: A multimorphing bitimbral synthesizer: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound.

entries.name: Arctic Scream
entries.author: p0larpatch
entries.description: Dark ambient drones and feedback screams from the frozen tundra. Built on GR!MM, with HOWL, a feedback-loop voice after the Synthux Audrey II that wakes out of silence and grows into a howl, and 46 arctic sounds.

entries.name: Chipbox
entries.author: Pasquale Barilla
entries.description: A chiptune groovebox with replicas of the NES, Game Boy and Sega Master System sound chips, in three views: RACK for the 16 steps of a page, CHIP to set up each channel, SONG to chain the pages into a song.

entries.name: FM-106
entries.author: PatttF
entries.description: The Juno-106 emulation of KR-106 ported to the FM-1: six voices on both cores, the BBD stereo chorus, 128 factory presets and a 1980s Roland look.

entries.name: Drumlab
entries.author: pbarilla
entries.description: Microtonic, for the FM-1! Roll the dice for a kit, build one from scratch, or bring in your Microtonic presets and patterns. Share kits and patterns as files, and send it all to your Teenage Engineering PO-32! Built on Chipbox!

entries.name: Smileyface
entries.author: pbarilla
entries.description: You're making acid, baby! Smash that LFO button until you hear something you like, and then twist those knobs! Now with 100% more FX! A truly trippy experience! Built on Chipbox.

entries.name: SPELLBOX
entries.author: Philippe Jaccoud
entries.description: SPELLBOX turns the FM-1 into a talking spelling toy after the 1978 Speak & Spell: an 8-character fluorescent display, a 10-pole LPC voice at 8 kHz through an 8-bit DAC, and the SPELL, LETTER, SAY IT, SECRET CODE and MYSTERY WORD games over four levels, with the keys as an A-to-Z keyboard. SPEAK…

entries.name: ECHOFIELD
entries.author: PhilipsKnobs
entries.description: A granular sampler: a few seconds of any sound become slow clouds, sparkles, tape loops and swells, played from the keys and knobs. 14 factory sounds, your own samples (or recorded over USB), filter, delay, reverb and tape, and a companion web app for samples, presets and recording.

entries.name: JAMTRACK
entries.author: PhilipsKnobs
entries.description: A backing band to play over: drums, bass, chords and a synth line follow your chords in any key and time signature, in time with a loop pedal. 160 factory jams in 16 genres, a new jam at a press, your own synth line on a piano roll, and a companion web app to edit and share jams.

entries.name: Piterfly
entries.author: Piotr Woźniak
entries.description: A groovebox OS for M-VAVE FM-1, built on SLOOP and Felucca: seven synth parts plus drums, 24 patterns, 128 SONG positions, clearer 64-step views, live granular INSERT, selective kick ducking and MIDI THRU for external instruments. Includes a browser editor with audio preview.

entries.name: hawk-chua
entries.author: plieuwski
entries.description: Noise and modeling synth with GM-style presets (4 banks, 512) and a 4-track tape recorder: each voice a live Chua circuit or noise program, through vactrol gates into resonators and piano, drum, voice, flute, brass, bowed, reed and bird waveguides, with temple, cathedral and mosque reverbs. XG…

entries.name: DARK-1
entries.author: Polystellarflow
entries.description: Dark-music firmware for the FM-1: 21 genres, 210 pieces, from dark techno and cinema to dark ambient, witch house and dungeon synth. Wander evolves it on its own. Step editor, own-voice arp, Dice, Auto FX, Drum Vary.

entries.name: Amenity
entries.author: Presethead
entries.description: A live jungle tool built around the Amen break. Hold white keys for rolls, builds, echo and Akai-style metallic stretch, play hits on the black keys, and shape the break with variation, warp, ringing feedback, lo-fi, EQ, saturation and compression.

entries.name: CHOPPAH
entries.author: profikid
entries.description: An Amen break chopper: eight classic breaks cut into 16 slices on the white keys, hold a key to loop it, and a generator that rearranges the break live, with a four-slot FX chain and a DJ filter.

entries.name: OPN-1
entries.author: putchdev
entries.description: The Sega Genesis / Mega Drive's Yamaha YM2612: six channels of 4-operator FM. Its web app takes patches from game music (VGM) and OPM files and streams VGM tunes to the FM-1 to play.

entries.name: SID-1
entries.author: putchdev
entries.description: The Commodore 64's SID chip, twice for six voices. Its web app edits patches and takes them straight from .sid game music files.

entries.name: ChoralRoot
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A port of the Choral Root synth.

entries.name: FIZZ
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A groovebox around one engine, ChoralRoot's FM TONE: eight tracks, p-locks and preset sound locks, conditions, ratchets, chords, and MIDI FX for generative patterns and for reworking the ones you have. Bluetooth MIDI, and recording over USB audio.

entries.name: PurpleMonkey
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A firmware for kids.

entries.name: RemoteFM1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: A firmware for your firmwares when using the app or a high quality 24bit DX7 rompler with 16 user carts and MIDI Controller when using the FM-1 by itself. BLE and USB supported!

entries.name: B3 ORGAN
entries.author: R-Jeb
entries.description: A B3 tonewheel organ: 91 wheels, nine drawbars, key click, vibrato and chorus, percussion, overdrive, reverb and a Leslie, computed from setBfree's own data and measured against it. All 110 setBfree programs and its default MIDI controllers.

entries.name: HYP-1
entries.author: RedtailWorks
entries.description: Hypnotic techno and acid: a breathing pad, a deep drone, a generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Flip patterns on the bar, break it down, build it up. Forked from AMB-1.

entries.name: SLOOP Floyd FM
entries.author: renebohne
entries.description: SLOOP with a four-operator FM engine after Floyd Steinberg's 4-OP idea: an envelope per operator and a live oscilloscope that draws the envelopes as you play.

entries.name: MIN-1
entries.author: Reytian
entries.description: A tiny minimalist ensemble after Philip Glass: it starts playing when you switch on, you join whenever you like. In EASY mode every white key is a chord that fits. Four models, twenty pieces.

entries.name: FMini-1
entries.author: Ruppert
entries.description: A three-oscillator monosynth in the spirit of the classic Moogs: a 24 dB/octave ladder filter, two contours, 100 factory patches, an arpeggiator, a sequencer and MIDI. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: bocjuhn
entries.author: ryuji kanagawa
entries.description: An experimental instrument with six tracks and eight sound engines. Play acid lines, trembling particles, fractured textures and percussion. Layer free loops or clocked sequences, shape them with grains and effects, and watch each engine come alive.

entries.name: COQUÍ
entries.author: saulofilho
entries.description: Latin and Caribbean groovebox: synthesized congas, bongos, timbales, guiro and cowbell, 14 grooves from salsa and bomba to dembow, tumbao and montuno lines over the chord you hold, generative parts in the clave, and effect scenes from a backyard to a dub.

entries.name: DUB-1
entries.author: sbegueria
entries.description: A generative dub techno machine that plays itself from the moment it is on: chord stabs into a tape echo, FM pings, a sub bass on five grooves, a ducking kick, crackle, and an eight-bar arrangement with breaks and fills.

entries.name: 386DX
entries.author: seajaysec
entries.description: A karaoke robot with a band: it sings songs from karaoke and MIDI files, or lines you type, to the notes you play. Its face is the voice. Keys, bass and drums play along, with a step sequencer and sixteen punch-in effects.

entries.name: Demake
entries.author: Sequencist
entries.description: An ambient lofi machine on 64 of its author's own pedal recordings: three synths, each with a piano roll, eight patterns, its own reverb, delay or tape echo and motion; huge shared reverbs, colour and old media over the whole mix; a chord machine and an arpeggiator, sixteen scenes, a song mode.

entries.name: Pocket GammaWave
entries.author: ShadowTune (GammaWave Audio)
entries.description: The companion to the GammaWave desktop synth: four industrial distortions, vowel and scream filters, an FFT spectrogram, a four-track tape deck screen and a song generator with 49 genres, trap and drill too.

entries.name: SLOOP ALG
entries.author: shaw-core
entries.description: A SLOOP test build with extra FM algorithms.

entries.name: ETCH
entries.author: SikkenWorks
entries.description: Draw the sound: a waveform drawn and changed with the knobs, morphed into another one, and a third modulating the result. An experimental build.

entries.name: MOPE-1
entries.author: slothpallas
entries.description: A sad wavetable synth played by a pixel blob in a rainy room: its eyes are the filter, its mouth the envelope, its tears the delay. Toy-keyboard accompaniment with 13 gloomy beats, auto-bass, arpeggiator, loop recorder.

entries.name: SPAMPY
entries.author: Spampy-Droid
entries.description: SLOOP in synthwave colours: 16 sound engines (OberVave's among them), 170 synth presets, 44 drum kits, scenes, effects, loudness per sound – and two arcade games built in, Neon Pang and Neon Bubbles.

entries.name: NOIZ DEMONS
entries.author: SPIKE the Percussionist
entries.description: Felucca with randomization as a ritual: every new sound summons one of 30 demons of the Ars Goetia, its sigil takes the screen and its rank decides how wild the sound gets.

entries.name: Mini-Tone
entries.author: Stéphane Schmitz
entries.description: Felucca with six tracks and new engines: SID, Braids' 48 models, a TB-303 and engines after Elektron's Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2, a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. Built on Felucca 1.5.

entries.name: Manifold
entries.author: stets43
entries.description: Generative just-intonation firmware for the FM-1. Two layers of moving points wander a map of 41 scales and play the notes they pass; a rhythm without a grid drives four drums that follow the synth. Four knobs steer it, the keys play into it, and it can stream to Bluetooth speakers.

entries.name: GuitChordi
entries.author: Stoogs
entries.description: A chord and string instrument: 16 synthesized sounds, 50 chord styles, editable voicings, guitar tunings, and Freeplay, Strum and Arp modes with partial-chord pulses.

entries.name: FRASIL
entries.author: Styves Goupil
entries.description: An ambient drone and texture instrument: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key, press to swell it. Three layers a voice into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze; GLINT plays icy FM bells on top, by hand, by arpeggiator or a 32-step sequencer, and BASS holds a deep note below.

entries.name: PIGEON
entries.author: The Shrimp Blimp
entries.description: An old-school hip-hop and house sampler after the SP-404 and the PO-33: two song samples and a 16-pad kit, up to 32 chops a song, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and a song arrangement. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: Tessera
entries.author: Theo Dainis (Rastapopolix)
entries.description: Generative music on four tracks: each plays its own steps, an arpeggio or one of 13 generators (Turing, Euclid, Markov, Constellation, Chord and more), and the tracks evolve, follow and modulate each other. EVOLVE and FORM grow phrases into songs; 16 mod cords connect anything. A Melodee fork.

entries.name: SiDJ
entries.author: thomasj (tubesockor)
entries.description: Plays C64 SID music from HVSC on an emulated 6581 or 8580 and lets you remix every voice live: transpose, mute, solo, swap waveforms, bend envelopes and filter, add LFOs, ride the tempo. Out of the jack, as USB audio or over ASID to a real SID. MIDI clock from the tune, or the tune synced to yours.

entries.name: Hungry Travis
entries.author: Trust This Mechanism
entries.description: A spoon-feeding balance game with a beatless ambient soundtrack and voiced reactions. Balance a bean, guide the spoon and try to feed Travis. Every fifth bite sets off a transformation.

entries.name: RAMBEAVER
entries.author: Trust This Mechanism
entries.description: A side-scrolling action game with synthesized music, sound effects and character voices. Defend the dam, ride through robot city, fly to the data center and stop Mother.

entries.name: Trumpagotchi
entries.author: Trust This Mechanism
entries.description: An unofficial parody virtual pet with a playable pentatonic keyboard. Feed, praise, clean up after and rest the pet. When he's happy, he joins your playing on bongos.

entries.name: CS-1
entries.author: twochannels
entries.description: A Yamaha CS-80 in spirit: eight voices of two channels, high- and low-pass filters in series, ring modulator, the touch response and 22 tones from the owner's manual. A sound module played over MIDI.

entries.name: XENOLITH
entries.author: Unit_v743
entries.description: An experimental mono-track FM cell synthesizer with programmable oscillator routing, modulation, sequencing, a vintage circuit-derived filter, VCA, wavefolding, digital fidelity reduction and reverb. A load engine models physical voltage sag and progressively shrinks resource usage under stress.

entries.name: MNM-1
entries.author: Veff
entries.description: Six monophonic tracks of synth and FX machines, pages of eight knobs, a filter and a tape delay on every track, three LFOs a track, parameter locks and slides. Forked from Hortator, with sounds ported from MONO2K.

entries.name: Veffbox
entries.author: Veff
entries.description: Resampling sound design. Build one sound from FM, analog or 808-style drums, play it as notes, steps or strummed chords, add 6 LFOs, 3 envelopes and 8 FX, then resample it into a new source. Every resample keeps its recipe, so a 64-sound bank of generation trees rebuilds bit for bit.

entries.name: Kris Jangle
entries.author: w33tSnx
entries.description: Kris Jangle is a Christmas game for the FM-1: it plays the start of a carol and you replay it on the keys, building three notes per level up to the whole song. Four carols, three play modes from guided EASY to sound-only HARD, and Grump Mode on three misses.

entries.name: Jangada
entries.author: zednaked
entries.description: Superwave analog voices and a modulation matrix.

entries.name: Arcturus S6
entries.author: Zeptosecond DSP
entries.description: An experimental, self-playing wavetable instrument for generative, evolving soundscapes. Four PPG-style oscillators, Serge-style function generators, sample-and-holds and logic, patched through mod and gate matrices. 12 bit, 22kHz, green phosphor CRT, Fairlight-style pages.

entries.name: Dinghy
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Your base for your own FM-1 firmware: everything under it done and documented (updates, USB rescue, USB-MIDI, USB audio, keys, screen, settings), a 4-voice sine on top. Fork it, replace the sine.

entries.name: FM-1 Doom
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Doom on the FM-1: one arena from FreeDM, played on the keys and a knob, on the FM-1's screen, with synthesised sound effects and no music.

entries.name: OberVave
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84: two oscillators a voice, sync, cross-mod, a 12 / 24 dB filter with a SEM-style morph, an arpeggiator with hold, chorus, ping-pong delay and a plate reverb. A two-track step sequencer played as sloopDX: live recordi…

entries.name: Shine On
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: A string ensemble in the spirit of the late-70s machines, grown out of OberVave: divide-down keyers with 16', 8' and 4' footages, register filters, a three-tap BBD ensemble and a phaser, on two tracks with the sequencer.

entries.name: sloopDX
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: SLOOP's live workflow with a six-operator DX7 engine from Dexed: 32 algorithms, your own .syx banks, every voice edited on the FM-1, and FM drums.

compat.note: crashes in the emulator a second or two after boot (a CPU exception at 0x0200338E: its own crash screen); held back until that is understood

entries.name: zp12
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: A 12-bit sampling drum machine after the E-mu SP-1200: 32 pads at 26 kHz with no interpolation, filtered channels on the knobs, loops and songs.
